name: QuantWare
description: QuantWare manufactures superconducting quantum processors for the global quantum computing industry. As a dedicated quantum chip supplier, they provide off-the-shelf and custom quantum processing units to research institutions and companies building quantum computers.

products.name: Contralto-D QPU
products.description: 21-qubit superconducting processor with tunable couplers, available off-the-shelf within 30 days

products.name: Soprano-D QPU
products.description: 5-qubit fixed-coupler processor for entry-level quantum computing and education

news.title: QuantWare Raises $178 Million to Build Quantum Processors at an Industrial Scale
news.excerpt: QuantWare raised $178 million in a Series B round as it advances a 10,000-qubit processor architecture and expands manufacturing capacity to meet growing global demand. The company's VIO™ modular architecture and planned KiloFab facility aim to overcome scaling constraints in superconducting systems.

news.title: QuantWare closes €152M (USD 178M) Series B to build KiloFab — the world's largest open-architecture quantum chip fabrication facility
news.excerpt: The round, the largest ever for a Dutch deep tech company and for any dedicated quantum processor startup worldwide, will fund a new Delft fab increasing production capacity 20x; new investors include Intel Capital and In-Q-Tel.
